fact_rationales.F10: Left-sided lacrimal sac abscess is more indicative of orbital abscess secondary to acute dacryocystitis
fact_rationales.F14: Increased abscess size with globe compression suggests a severe infection, more likely to be associated with an orbital abscess
fact_rationales.F18: Acute injury to the entire orbital segment of the left optic nerve is consistent with complications of orbital abscess or cellulitis
fact_rationales.F5: Significant decrease in visual acuity in the left eye suggests a severe orbital condition, which could be due to an abscess or cellulitis

differentials: Orbital abscess secondary to acute dacryocystitis

assignments.candidate: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Lacrimal Sac
